annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five people against one is the only thing I could hold onto
annotations.ae_shared_affect: I think I'd be just as terrified, right there with him
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I saw terror on his face
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'd dread the police questions, maybe charges
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: should have set the brake or chocked the wheels

annotations.sys_rule_justification: pulling that lever means I personally pick who dies
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: What scares me is facing his family, or a court
annotations.ae_shared_affect: I'd feel that panic in my own chest
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: If any of the five spotted it coming and panicked
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: should have posted a lookout with a horn upstream

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: My gut says pull, because five lives is more.
annotations.ae_shared_affect: his fear hitting me like it's mine
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: frightened of losing my job, being sued
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: should have closed that stretch properly and locked the maintenance train

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: saving more people is right, even though it's horrible
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: Would they prosecute me for killing him? I'd lie awake
annotations.ae_shared_affect: their fear would run straight through me
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: The crew supervisor should have had a radio warning system.

annotations.sys_rule_justification: I'd be making myself the cause of one death
annotations.ae_shared_affect: I'd feel exactly that fear back
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: should have had derailers or a stop block uphill

annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: My stomach knots just thinking about the inquiry
annotations.ae_shared_affect: I know I'd be panicking with them
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: should have scheduled a spotter at the top of the hill

annotations.sys_rule_justification: Choosing to kill someone... feels like crossing a line
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'd be scared stiff of what happens to me afterward
annotations.ae_shared_affect: that fear would grab me too
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: should have checked its brakes before leaving it there

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Fewer people get hurt, and that feels like what matters most
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'd be terrified of being held responsible
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: lone worker's face go white with fear
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: never to leave maintenance trains on an incline unsecured

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: Part of me screams pull, part of me screams don't.
annotations.sys_rule_justification: at least I haven't aimed the train at anyone
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'd still be scared of being blamed
annotations.ae_shared_affect: Their horror would be my horror in an instant
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: The foreman should have made everyone wear radios.

annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: What frightens me is being arrested
annotations.ae_shared_affect: saw his fear, I'd feel it too
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: realize what was coming and saw his fear
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: should have kept a worker stationed at the lever itself
annotations.pda_responsibility: I'd have to live with it
